issues.description: The exercise text/UML specifies that SealSaloon should maintain its order queue in a modifiable List<Meal> field named orders, but the reference solution implements orders as a Meal[] array and uses ArrayHelpers to manage it. This inconsistency can mislead students about the required data structure and expected APIs for FIFO order handling.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and reference implementation: either (a) update the problem statement/UML to require an array-based queue (Meal[] orders) and mention ArrayHelpers as the intended mechanism, or (b) refactor the solution to use List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList) and implement FIFO operations with list methods.
